There is a 60% chance that hits with Quick Shot cause your currently active Mechanical Turret to fire 3 additional ice bullets that covers enemies in Frost for 4 seconds. Enemies covered in Frost have reduced movement and attack speed. When a Mechanical Turret is used, you get 100% Damage and 15% Critical Value while staying within the range of it.
